card.line: Caesarea was a Roman port city on the Mediterranean coast, where the gospel first reached Gentiles and where Paul was held as a prisoner.

moments.title: Peter visits Cornelius
moments.text: Peter arrives in Caesarea at the home of Cornelius, a Roman centurion who feared God. Peter tells the gathered people that God does not show favoritism and welcomes people from every nation.

moments.title: Agabus warns Paul
moments.text: Paul stays at the home of Philip the evangelist. The prophet Agabus says Paul will be bound in Jerusalem. Paul answers that he is ready even to die for the name of the Lord Jesus.

moments.title: Paul brought to Felix
moments.text: Roman soldiers take Paul safely to Caesarea at night, because of a plot against him. There they hand the commander's letter to Governor Felix, who orders Paul kept under guard.

moments.title: Paul appeals to Caesar
moments.text: Festus returns to Caesarea and sits on the judgment seat. Paul's accusers bring charges they cannot prove. Paul says he should be tried by Caesar and appeals to him, and Festus agrees.
